PROBE_NEW = r'''/**
 * Unit test for the unified HELP protocol.
 *
 * T1. Broken JSON with a valid "message" is salvaged. Dialog continues.
 * T2. Three garbage attempts in a row → orchestrator HELP, no
 *     protocol_violation stop. IMPOSSIBLE from the other agent ends
 *     the task with reason deadlock.
 * T3. HELP → HELP_RESPONSE → SOLVED → done.
 * T4. IMPOSSIBLE from Executor → stop('deadlock'); plan preserved.
 * T5. Help loop across two full rounds — orchestrator HELP fires
 *     more than once; the task ends with IMPOSSIBLE, not with a
 *     hard stop.
 *
 * Run:
 *   npx ts-node --project scripts/tsconfig.json scripts/probe-help-protocol.ts
 */

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as os from 'os';
import * as path from 'path';
import { ApiClient } from '../src/api';
import { Executor } from '../src/executor';
import { Logger } from '../src/log';
import { NullPanel, Orchestrator } from '../src/orchestrator';
import { AssistantResponse, ExecResult } from '../src/types';

let failures = 0;

function check(condition: boolean, label: string): void {
  if (condition) {
    console.log(`  \u2713 ${label}`);
  } else {
    console.error(`  \u2717 ${label}`);
    failures++;
  }
}

function freshTmp(name: string): string {
  const p = path.join(os.tmpdir(),
    `${name}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`);
  fs.mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true });
  return p;
}

type Step =
  | { kind: 'broken'; text: string }
  | { kind: 'tools'; calls: { name: string; args: any }[] };

class FakeApi {
  public newChatCalls = 0;
  constructor(private who: string, private script: Step[]) {}
  private idx = 0;
  async newChat(): Promise<void> { this.newChatCalls++; }
  async chat(): Promise<AssistantResponse> {
    if (this.idx >= this.script.length) {
      throw new Error(`FakeApi(${this.who}): script exhausted`);
    }
    const s = this.script[this.idx++];
    if (s.kind === 'broken') {
      return { text: s.text, tool_calls: [], raw: {} };
    }
    return {
      text: '',
      tool_calls: s.calls.map((c, i) => ({
        id: `call_${this.idx}_${i}`,
        name: c.name as any,
        args: c.args
      })) as any,
      raw: {}
    };
  }
}

class FakeExecutor {
  async run(call_id: string, script: string): Promise<ExecResult> {
    return {
      call_id, command: 'noop', exit_code: 0, duration_ms: 1,
      stdout: 'ok\n', stderr: '',
      stdout_truncated: false, stderr_truncated: false
    };
  }
}

function mkLog(cwd: string): Logger {
  return new Logger(cwd, { appendLine: () => { /* silent */ } });
}

async function runOrch(
  cwd: string,
  apiE: FakeApi,
  apiC: FakeApi,
  task = 'stub'
): Promise<void> {
  const log = mkLog(cwd);
  const orch = new Orchestrator(
    apiE as unknown as ApiClient,
    apiC as unknown as ApiClient,
    new FakeExecutor() as unknown as Executor,
    new NullPanel(),
    log,
    {
      cwd, name: 'probe-help-protocol', task,
      timeoutMs: 30_000,
      executorPrompt: 'E', criticPrompt: 'C'
    }
  );
  await orch.run();
  log.close();
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200));
}

function readLog(cwd: string): any[] {
  const logPath = path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'session.log');
  if (!fs.existsSync(logPath)) return [];
  return fs.readFileSync(logPath, 'utf-8')
    .split('\n').filter(Boolean).map(l => JSON.parse(l));
}

async function t1_salvage_from_broken_message(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT1: broken JSON with valid "message" is salvaged');

  const cwd = freshTmp('probe-hp-t1');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md'), '# Plan\n');

  const brokenJson =
    '{"tool_calls":[{"name":"send_message","arguments":' +
    '{"to":"critic","message":"APPROVE_PLAN"';

  const apiE = new FakeApi('executor', [
    { kind: 'broken', text: brokenJson }
  ]);
  const apiC = new FakeApi('critic', [
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'execute', args: { script: 'print(1)' } }] },
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'finalize', args: { comment: 'ok' } }] }
  ]);

  await runOrch(cwd, apiE, apiC);
  const lines = readLog(cwd);

  const salvaged = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'response' && e.salvaged === true
      && e.kind === 'message_extracted'
  );
  const routed = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'route' && e.from === 'executor' && e.to === 'critic'
      && typeof e.message === 'string' && e.message.includes('APPROVE_PLAN')
  );
  const stop = lines.find(e => e.event === 'stop');

  check(!!salvaged, 'message_extracted salvage event present');
  check(!!routed, 'APPROVE_PLAN routed to critic');
  check(stop?.reason === 'done', `stop reason = ${stop?.reason} (expected done)`);
}

async function t2_garbage_escalates_to_help(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT2: three garbage attempts → HELP, then IMPOSSIBLE');

  const cwd = freshTmp('probe-hp-t2');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md'), '# Plan\n');

  const apiE = new FakeApi('executor', [
    { kind: 'broken', text: 'not json at all' },
    { kind: 'broken', text: 'still garbage' },
    { kind: 'broken', text: 'garbage again' },
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'critic', message: 'IMPOSSIBLE: cannot reformat' } }] }
  ]);
  const apiC = new FakeApi('critic', [
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'executor', message: 'HELP_RESPONSE: try shorter' } }] }
  ]);

  await runOrch(cwd, apiE, apiC);
  const lines = readLog(cwd);

  const retry1 = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'error' && e.code === 'no_tool_calls' && e.retry === 1
  );
  const retry2 = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'error' && e.code === 'no_tool_calls' && e.retry === 2
  );
  const orchHelp = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'help' && e.initiator === 'orchestrator'
  );
  const stop = lines.find(e => e.event === 'stop');

  check(!!retry1, 'retry 1 (L1a) logged');
  check(!!retry2, 'retry 2 (L1b) logged');
  check(!!orchHelp, 'orchestrator-initiated HELP logged');
  check(stop?.reason !== 'protocol_violation',
    `stop reason = ${stop?.reason} (must not be protocol_violation)`);
  check(stop?.reason === 'deadlock',
    `stop reason = ${stop?.reason} (expected deadlock from IMPOSSIBLE)`);
}

async function t3_help_loop_and_solved(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT3: HELP → HELP_RESPONSE → SOLVED → done');

  const cwd = freshTmp('probe-hp-t3');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md'), '# Plan\n');

  const apiE = new FakeApi('executor', [
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'critic', message: 'HELP:\nProblem: x\nTried: y' } }] },
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'critic', message: 'SOLVED: it worked' } }] },
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'critic', message: 'ALL DONE: ok' } }] }
  ]);
  const apiC = new FakeApi('critic', [
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'execute', args: { script: 'print(1)' } }] },
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'executor', message: 'HELP_RESPONSE: try X' } }] },
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'finalize', args: { comment: 'ok' } }] }
  ]);

  await runOrch(cwd, apiE, apiC);
  const lines = readLog(cwd);

  const helpSent = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'help' && e.phase === 'HELP'
  );
  const helpResp = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'help' && e.phase === 'HELP_RESPONSE'
  );
  const solved = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'help' && e.phase === 'SOLVED'
  );
  const stop = lines.find(e => e.event === 'stop');

  check(!!helpSent, 'HELP event logged');
  check(!!helpResp, 'HELP_RESPONSE event logged');
  check(!!solved, 'SOLVED event logged');
  check(stop?.reason === 'done', `stop reason = ${stop?.reason} (expected done)`);
}

async function t4_impossible_stops_task(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT4: IMPOSSIBLE → deadlock, plan preserved');

  const cwd = freshTmp('probe-hp-t4');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md'), '# Plan\nreal content\n');

  const apiE = new FakeApi('executor', [
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'critic', message: 'IMPOSSIBLE: cannot solve' } }] }
  ]);
  const apiC = new FakeApi('critic', []);

  await runOrch(cwd, apiE, apiC);
  const lines = readLog(cwd);

  const stop = lines.find(e => e.event === 'stop');
  const summary = path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'summary.md');
  const plan = path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md');

  check(stop?.reason === 'deadlock',
    `stop reason = ${stop?.reason} (expected deadlock)`);
  check(fs.existsSync(summary), 'fallback summary written');
  check(fs.existsSync(plan), 'plan.md preserved (graceful shutdown)');
}

async function t5_help_loop_no_stop(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT5: two full HELP rounds, then IMPOSSIBLE — no hard stop');

  const cwd = freshTmp('probe-hp-t5');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md'), '# Plan\n');

  const apiE = new FakeApi('executor', [
    { kind: 'broken', text: 'r1 garbage a' },
    { kind: 'broken', text: 'r1 garbage b' },
    { kind: 'broken', text: 'r1 garbage c' },
    { kind: 'broken', text: 'r2 garbage a' },
    { kind: 'broken', text: 'r2 garbage b' },
    { kind: 'broken', text: 'r2 garbage c' },
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'critic', message: 'IMPOSSIBLE: endless format failure' } }] }
  ]);
  const apiC = new FakeApi('critic', [
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'executor', message: 'HELP_RESPONSE: try a smaller reply' } }] },
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'executor', message: 'HELP_RESPONSE: split into two calls' } }] }
  ]);

  await runOrch(cwd, apiE, apiC);
  const lines = readLog(cwd);

  const helpEvents = lines.filter(
    e => e.event === 'help' && e.initiator === 'orchestrator'
  );
  const stop = lines.find(e => e.event === 'stop');

  check(helpEvents.length >= 2,
    `orchestrator HELP fired ${helpEvents.length} time(s) (>= 2)`);
  check(stop?.reason === 'deadlock',
    `stop reason = ${stop?.reason} (expected deadlock)`);
  check(stop?.reason !== 'protocol_violation',
    'stop reason is not protocol_violation');
}

async function main(): Promise<void> {
  await t1_salvage_from_broken_message();
  await t2_garbage_escalates_to_help();
  await t3_help_loop_and_solved();
  await t4_impossible_stops_task();
  await t5_help_loop_no_stop();

  console.log();
  if (failures === 0) {
    console.log('=== SUCCESS: HELP protocol works ===');
    process.exit(0);
  } else {
    console.log(`=== FAILURE: ${failures} check(s) failed ===`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

main().catch(e => {
  console.error('CRASH:', e);
  process.exit(2);
});

# ===========================================================================
# 7. CHANGELOG.md — 0.3.4
# ===========================================================================

CHANGELOG_OLD = "## [0.3.3] - 2026-10-15"

CHANGELOG_NEW = """## [0.3.4] - 2026-10-15

### Fixed

- Malformed tool calls (`execute` without a script, `send_message`
  without a message, invalid addressee, self-message) now retry once
  with a hint instead of stopping the task immediately. If the retry
  also fails, the orchestrator hands off to the other agent via HELP.
- The help-loop hints (L1a and L1b) are now attached to the current
  request instead of being queued as separate messages. Previously
  the agent never saw them — the loop kept re-asking the same
  question while a stack of unused hints accumulated in its queue.
  This was the root cause of runs where Executor made 80+ attempts
  and Critic never got a turn.
- The L4 stop (`protocol_violation` after repeated failed attempts)
  is removed. The HELP loop is now closed only by IMPOSSIBLE from
  either agent or by the task timeout — matching the design of the
  HELP protocol.
- When HELP is synthesized, the recipient's queue is replaced rather
  than appended to, so there is never more than one pending message
  per agent.

### Changed

- Executor and Critic prompts: IMPOSSIBLE is now documented as a
  valid outcome after several honest HELP / HELP_RESPONSE rounds
  without a new concrete direction, rather than only for external
  impossibility.

"""

def bump_version() -> None:
    p = ROOT / 'package.json'
    if not p.exists():
        print('  ! package.json not found')
        return
    backup('package.json')
    data = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    old = data.get('version', '?')
    data['version'] = '0.3.4'
    p.write_text(
        json.dumps(data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n',
        encoding='utf-8'
    )
    print(f'  package.json: {old} -> 0.3.4')

    print('--- src/orchestrator.ts ---')

    print()
    print('--- package.json ---')
    bump_version()

    if not run_cmd(['npm', 'run', 'compile'], 'npm run compile'):

    if not run_cmd(['npm', 'run', 'typecheck:scripts'], 'npm run typecheck:scripts'):
        print('Aborting: typecheck failed.')

    ok = True

                 'probe:help-protocol', 'probe:retry']:
        ok &= run_cmd(['npm', 'run', name], name)
    if not ok:
        print('Aborting: tests failed. Changes are on disk, not committed.')
        return 4

    print()
    print('=== Commit ===')
    git_commit('step37: attach hints to request, remove L4 stop, HELP loop (0.3.4)')

    print()

===== FILE: scripts/dev/apply_step38_marker_restart.py =====
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Step 38: project marker + manual restart button.

Two independent changes:

1. Project marker.
   Before this change, resume was decided only by the presence of
   .pingis/plan.md. A plan.md left over from project A could cause a
   task in project B to reuse project A's chat. Now the orchestrator
   also checks a `.last-project` marker in each agent's state dir
   (~/.pingis/deepseek-agents/agents/agent-N/.last-project). Resume
   happens only when plan.md exists AND both markers point to the
   current cwd. Otherwise chats are reset and markers are rewritten.

2. Manual restart button.
   A "Restart in fresh chat" button in the progress view. Clicking it
   stops the current run, resets both chats via POST /v1/chat/new, and
   starts the same task again. plan.md is preserved (same task), the
   Executor re-reads it and continues — the model just starts with a
   clean conversation history.

Run from pingis/:
    python scripts/dev/apply_step38_marker_restart.py
"""

import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent
BACKUP = ROOT / '.backup' / 'dev-snapshot-v10'


def backup(rel: str) -> None:
    src = ROOT / rel
    if not src.exists():
        return
    dst = BACKUP / rel
    dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(src, dst)


def patch(rel: str, pairs: list) -> int:
    p = ROOT / rel
    if not p.exists():
        print(f'  ! {rel} not found')
        return 0
    backup(rel)
    text = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    total = 0
    for old, new in pairs:
        n = text.count(old)
        if n == 0:
            print(f'  ! {rel}: pattern not found: {old[:70]!r}')
            continue
        text = text.replace(old, new)
        total += n
        print(f'  {rel}: {n} x {old[:60]!r}')
    p.write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')
    return total


def run_cmd(cmd: list, label: str) -> bool:
    print()
    print(f'=== {label} ===')
    print('$ ' + ' '.join(cmd))
    r = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=ROOT)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        print(f'  x {label} failed (exit {r.returncode})')
        return False
    print(f'  + {label} ok')
    return True


def git_commit(message: str) -> None:
    if not (ROOT / '.git').exists():
        print('  git: no repo, skipping commit')
        return
    try:
        subprocess.run(['git', 'add', '-A'], cwd=ROOT,
                       check=True, capture_output=True)
        subprocess.run(['git', 'commit', '-m', message], cwd=ROOT,
                       check=True, capture_output=True)
        print(f'  git: committed "{message}"')
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
        print(f'  git: commit failed ({e})')

  | 'user_restart'
  | 'crash';"""

  | { type: 'ready' }

  | { type: 'stop' }

  | { type: 'restart' }

ORCH_OPTS_OLD = """export interface OrchestratorOptions {

  name: string;
  task: string;

  executorPrompt: string;
  criticPrompt: string;

ORCH_OPTS_NEW = """export interface OrchestratorOptions {
  cwd: string;
  name: string;
  task: string;
  timeoutMs: number;
  executorPrompt: string;
  criticPrompt: string;
  initialFiles?: string[];
  /**
   * Absolute paths to the per-agent state dirs under
   * ~/.pingis/deepseek-agents/agents/agent-N/. When provided, the
   * orchestrator writes and checks a `.last-project` marker so that a
   * chat belonging to one project is not silently reused by another.
   *
   * Optional: probe scripts leave it unset and keep the previous
   * behaviour (plan.md alone decides).
   */
  agentDirs?: { executor: string; critic: string };
}"""


PLAN_CHECK_OLD = """    // Artifact-based continuation decision.
    //   plan.md present  -> resume: leave chats as-is.
    //   plan.md absent   -> new task: reset both chats, so no history
    //                       leaks from the previous task.
    const planPath = path.join(this.opts.cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md');
    if (!fs.existsSync(planPath)) {
      try {
        await this.apiE.newChat(sessionE, false);
        await this.apiC.newChat(sessionC, false);
        this.log.event('orchestrator', 'artifact', {
          action: 'reset',
          kind: 'chats',
          reason: 'no plan.md'
        });
      } catch (e) {
        this.log.event('orchestrator', 'error', {
          stage: 'chat_reset',
          code: 'new_chat_failed',
          detail: String(e)
        });
      }
    } else {
      this.log.event('orchestrator', 'artifact', {
        action: 'resume',
        kind: 'chats',
        reason: 'plan.md present',
        path: planPath
      });
    }"""

PLAN_CHECK_NEW = """    // Artifact-based continuation decision.
    //   plan.md present AND marker matches -> resume: leave chats as-is.
    //   Otherwise -> new task: reset both chats.
    //
    // The `.last-project` marker in each agent's state dir records
    // which project the current chat belongs to. Without it, a plan.md
    // left over from one project could cause another project's task to
    // reuse the same chat.
    const planPath = path.join(this.opts.cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md');
    const hasPlan = fs.existsSync(planPath);

    // Default to true when agentDirs are not provided (probe tests,
    // legacy callers) — keeps the previous behaviour.
    let projectMatches = true;
    if (this.opts.agentDirs) {
      projectMatches = false;
      try {
        const markerE = path.join(this.opts.agentDirs.executor, '.last-project');
        const markerC = path.join(this.opts.agentDirs.critic, '.last-project');
        const eVal = fs.readFileSync(markerE, 'utf-8').trim();
        const cVal = fs.readFileSync(markerC, 'utf-8').trim();
        projectMatches = (eVal === this.opts.cwd && cVal === this.opts.cwd);
      } catch { /* markers missing or unreadable */ }
    }

    if (!hasPlan || !projectMatches) {
      try {
        await this.apiE.newChat(sessionE, false);
        await this.apiC.newChat(sessionC, false);
        this.log.event('orchestrator', 'artifact', {
          action: 'reset',
          kind: 'chats',
          reason: !hasPlan ? 'no plan.md' : 'project marker mismatch'
        });

        if (this.opts.agentDirs) {
          try {
            const markerE = path.join(this.opts.agentDirs.executor, '.last-project');
            const markerC = path.join(this.opts.agentDirs.critic, '.last-project');
            fs.mkdirSync(this.opts.agentDirs.executor, { recursive: true });
            fs.mkdirSync(this.opts.agentDirs.critic, { recursive: true });
            fs.writeFileSync(markerE, this.opts.cwd, 'utf-8');
            fs.writeFileSync(markerC, this.opts.cwd, 'utf-8');
          } catch (e) {
            this.log.event('orchestrator', 'error', {
              stage: 'project_marker',
              code: 'write_failed',
              detail: String(e)
            });
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {
        this.log.event('orchestrator', 'error', {
          stage: 'chat_reset',
          code: 'new_chat_failed',
          detail: String(e)
        });
      }
    } else {
      this.log.event('orchestrator', 'artifact', {
        action: 'resume',
        kind: 'chats',
        reason: 'plan.md present and project matches',
        path: planPath
      });
    }"""

PANEL_LOOP_NEW = """    this.post({ type: 'showProgress', name });

    const taskStartedAt = Date.now();
    const totalTimeoutMs = timeoutMin * 60_000;

    // Outer loop: one iteration per "task run". Normally there is
    // exactly one iteration. The loop runs again only when the user
    // clicked "Restart in fresh chat" during the run: chats are reset,
    // plan.md is preserved, and the same task starts over.
    while (true) {
      this.restartRequested = false;

      const result = await runWithRetry({
        taskStartedAt,
        totalTimeoutMs,
        maxRetries: MAX_RETRIES,
        backoffMs: RETRY_BACKOFF_MS,
        minRemainingMs: MIN_REMAINING_MS,
        isRetryable: (r) => RETRYABLE_STOP_REASONS.has(r),
        log: (event, payload) => {
          this.log?.event('orchestrator', 'retry', {
            __phase: event,
            ...payload
          });
        },
        runOnce: async (remainingMs) => {
          // Fresh ApiClient / Executor per attempt: on retry the agent
          // ports and keys come from the freshly started deployment.
          const apiE = new ApiClient({
            baseUrl: `http://127.0.0.1:${this.agents!.executor.port}`,
            apiKey: this.agents!.executor.apiKey,
            logger: this.log!
          });
          const apiC = new ApiClient({
            baseUrl: `http://127.0.0.1:${this.agents!.critic.port}`,
            apiKey: this.agents!.critic.apiKey,
            logger: this.log!
          });
          const exec = new Executor(cwd, this.log!, execTimeoutSec * 1000);

          this.orchestrator = new Orchestrator(apiE, apiC, exec, this, this.log!, {
            cwd,
            name,
            task,
            timeoutMs: remainingMs,
            executorPrompt: prompts.executorPrompt,
            criticPrompt: prompts.criticPrompt,
            initialFiles: attachmentPaths.length > 0 ? attachmentPaths : undefined,
            agentDirs: {
              executor: this.agents!.executor.dir,
              critic: this.agents!.critic.dir
            }
          });

          return await this.orchestrator.run();
        },
        onRetry: async (attempt, max) => {
          this.post({ type: 'retrying', attempt, max });
          this.agents?.stop();
          this.agents = new AgentsProcess(apiDir, this.log!);
          await this.agents.ensureRunning();
        }
      });

      this.post({ type: 'retryDone' });

      if (!this.restartRequested) {
        this.done(result.reason, result.summary);
        return;
      }

      // Manual restart: chats were signalled to reset via
      // orchestrator.stop('user_restart'). Now do the actual POST
      // /v1/chat/new on both agents and loop back.
      this.log?.event('orchestrator', 'retry', {
        __phase: 'manual_restart',
        reason: 'user_restart'
      });
      try {
        await resetChatInPlace(
          this.agents!.executor.port,
          this.agents!.executor.apiKey
        );
        await resetChatInPlace(
          this.agents!.critic.port,
          this.agents!.critic.apiKey
        );
      } catch (e) {
        this.log?.event('orchestrator', 'error', {
          stage: 'restart',
          code: 'chat_reset_failed',
          detail: String(e)
        });
        this.done('server_error', String(e));
        return;
      }
    }
  }"""

    throw new Error(`chat reset failed: HTTP ${r.status}`);
  }
}

def main() -> int:
    if not (ROOT / 'package.json').exists() or not (ROOT / 'src').exists():
        print('ERROR: run from the pingis/ extension root.')
        return 1
    BACKUP.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    print('--- src/types.ts ---')
    patch('src/types.ts', [
        (TYPES_STOP_OLD, TYPES_STOP_NEW),

    ])

    print()
    print('--- src/orchestrator.ts ---')
    patch('src/orchestrator.ts', [
        (ORCH_OPTS_OLD, ORCH_OPTS_NEW),
        (PLAN_CHECK_OLD, PLAN_CHECK_NEW),
    ])

    print()
    print('--- src/panel.ts ---')
    patch('src/panel.ts', [
        (PANEL_FIELD_OLD, PANEL_FIELD_NEW),
        (PANEL_MSG_OLD, PANEL_MSG_NEW),
        (PANEL_LOOP_OLD, PANEL_LOOP_NEW),
        (PANEL_HELPER_ANCHOR, PANEL_HELPER_INSERT + PANEL_HELPER_ANCHOR),
    ])

    print()
    print('--- media/panel.html ---')
    patch('media/panel.html', [(HTML_OLD, HTML_NEW)])

    print()
    print('--- media/panel.js ---')
    patch('media/panel.js', [
        (JS_HANDLER_OLD, JS_HANDLER_NEW),
        (JS_REASON_OLD, JS_REASON_NEW),
    ])

    if not run_cmd(['npm', 'run', 'compile'], 'npm run compile'):
        print('Aborting: compile failed.')
        return 2
    if not run_cmd(['npm', 'run', 'typecheck:scripts'], 'npm run typecheck:scripts'):
        print('Aborting: typecheck failed.')
        return 3

    print()
    print('=== Unit tests ===')
    ok = True
    for name in ['probe:409', 'probe:help', 'probe:artifacts',
                 'probe:help-protocol', 'probe:retry']:
        ok &= run_cmd(['npm', 'run', name], name)
    if not ok:
        print('Aborting: tests failed. Changes are on disk, not committed.')
        return 4

    print()
    print('=== Commit ===')
    git_commit('step38: project marker for chat continuity + manual restart button')

    print()
    print('Done. Rollback: cp -r .backup/dev-snapshot-v10/* .')
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())

===== FILE: scripts/dev/apply_step39_remove_restart.py =====
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Step 39: remove the manual restart button.

The button was added in step38. Its implementation had a bug:
resetChatInPlace() used fetch() without an AbortController, so a
half-dead agent could leave the fetch hanging forever, freezing the
elapsed-time tick and making the extension appear stuck.

The project marker (.last-project) introduced in the same step is
kept; only the button and its machinery are removed.

Run from pingis/:
    python scripts/dev/apply_step39_remove_restart.py
"""

import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent
BACKUP = ROOT / '.backup' / 'dev-snapshot-v11'


def backup(rel: str) -> None:
    src = ROOT / rel
    if not src.exists():
        return
    dst = BACKUP / rel
    dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(src, dst)


def patch(rel: str, pairs: list) -> int:
    p = ROOT / rel
    if not p.exists():
        print(f'  ! {rel} not found')
        return 0
    backup(rel)
    text = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    total = 0
    for old, new in pairs:
        n = text.count(old)
        if n == 0:
            print(f'  ! {rel}: pattern not found: {old[:70]!r}')
            continue
        text = text.replace(old, new)
        total += n
        print(f'  {rel}: {n} x {old[:60]!r}')
    p.write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')
    return total


def run_cmd(cmd: list, label: str) -> bool:
    print()
    print(f'=== {label} ===')
    print('$ ' + ' '.join(cmd))
    r = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=ROOT)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        print(f'  x {label} failed (exit {r.returncode})')
        return False
    print(f'  + {label} ok')
    return True


def git_commit(message: str) -> None:
    if not (ROOT / '.git').exists():
        print('  git: no repo, skipping commit')
        return
    try:
        subprocess.run(['git', 'add', '-A'], cwd=ROOT,
                       check=True, capture_output=True)
        subprocess.run(['git', 'commit', '-m', message], cwd=ROOT,
                       check=True, capture_output=True)
        print(f'  git: committed "{message}"')
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
        print(f'  git: commit failed ({e})')

        ok &= run_cmd(['npm', 'run', name], name)
    if not ok:
        print('Aborting: tests failed. Changes are on disk, not committed.')
        return 4

    print()
    print('=== Commit ===')
    git_commit('step39: remove manual restart button (kept project marker)')

    print()
    print('Done. Rollback: cp -r .backup/dev-snapshot-v11/* .')
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())
===== END FILE: scripts/dev/apply_step39_remove_restart.py =====

===== FILE: scripts/probe-409.ts =====
/**
 * Unit test for 409 context_exhausted handling.
 *
 * Mocks ApiClient and Executor. No real API servers needed.
 * Checks:
 *   1. deadE = true after 409 on the Executor side.
 *   2. Critic receives CONTEXT_LIMIT and calls finalize.
 *   3. stop reason=done (not context_exhausted).
 *
 * Run:
 *   npx ts-node --project scripts/tsconfig.json scripts/probe-409.ts
 */

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as os from 'os';
import * as path from 'path';
import { ApiClient } from '../src/api';
import { Executor } from '../src/executor';
import { Logger } from '../src/log';
import { NullPanel, Orchestrator } from '../src/orchestrator';
import { AssistantResponse, ExecResult, StopError } from '../src/types';

const TMP = path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'probe-409-' + Date.now());
fs.mkdirSync(TMP, { recursive: true });
console.log('TMP:', TMP);

const log = new Logger(TMP, {
  appendLine: (s: string) => console.log(s)
});

type Step = 'execute' | 'send_message' | 'finalize' | '409';

class FakeApi {
  private count = 0;
  constructor(
    private who: string,
    private script: Step[]
  ) {}

  async newChat(): Promise<void> {
    /* no-op */
  }

  async chat(): Promise<AssistantResponse> {
    const step = this.script[this.count++];
    console.log(`[fake-${this.who}] step #${this.count}: ${step}`);

    if (step === '409') {
      throw new StopError('context_exhausted', `fake ${this.who}`);
    }

    if (step === 'execute') {
      return {
        text: '',
        tool_calls: [{
          id: `call_${this.count}`,
          name: 'execute',
          args: { script: 'print("noop")' }
        } as any],
        raw: {}
      };
    }

    if (step === 'send_message') {
      return {
        text: '',
        tool_calls: [{
          id: `call_${this.count}`,
          name: 'send_message',
          args: this.who === 'executor'
            ? { to: 'critic', message: 'STAGE 1/1 DONE: done' }
            : { to: 'executor', message: 'APPROVE_STAGE' }
        } as any],
        raw: {}
      };
    }

    if (step === 'finalize') {
      return {
        text: '',
        tool_calls: [{
          id: `call_${this.count}`,
          name: 'finalize',
          args: { comment: 'Executor context exhausted. Saved 1/1.' }
        } as any],
        raw: {}
      };
    }

    throw new Error('unknown step: ' + step);
  }
}

class FakeExecutor {
  async run(call_id: string, script: string, command?: string): Promise<ExecResult> {
    console.log(`[fake-exec] script len=${script.length}`);
    return {
      call_id,
      command: command ?? 'noop',
      exit_code: 0,
      duration_ms: 1,
      stdout: 'noop\n',
      stderr: '',
      stdout_truncated: false,
      stderr_truncated: false
    };
  }
}

// E: execute -> send_message -> 409
// C: send_message (APPROVE_STAGE) -> finalize
const fakeApiE = new FakeApi('executor', ['execute', 'send_message', '409']);
const fakeApiC = new FakeApi('critic', ['send_message', 'finalize']);

async function readLogWhenReady(logPath: string, timeoutMs = 3000): Promise<string> {
  const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
  while (Date.now() < deadline) {
    if (fs.existsSync(logPath)) {
      const text = fs.readFileSync(logPath, 'utf-8');
      if (text.includes('"event":"stop"')) return text;
    }
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 50));
  }
  return fs.existsSync(logPath) ? fs.readFileSync(logPath, 'utf-8') : '';
}

async function main() {
  const orch = new Orchestrator(
    fakeApiE as unknown as ApiClient,
    fakeApiC as unknown as ApiClient,
    new FakeExecutor() as unknown as Executor,
    new NullPanel(),
    log,
    {
      cwd: TMP,
      name: 'probe-409',
      task: 'Stub task for 409 handling test.',
      timeoutMs: 60_000,
      executorPrompt: 'EXECUTOR_PROMPT',
      criticPrompt: 'CRITIC_PROMPT'
    }
  );

  await orch.run();
  log.close();

  const logPath = path.join(TMP, '.pingis', 'session.log');
  const logText = await readLogWhenReady(logPath);
  const lines = logText
    .split('\n')
    .filter(Boolean)
    .map(l => JSON.parse(l));

  const stopEvent = lines.find(e => e.event === 'stop');
  const exhaustedEvent = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'error' && e.code === 'executor_exhausted'
  );
  const criticFinalize = lines.find(
    e => e.who === 'critic'
      && e.event === 'response'
      && Array.isArray(e.tool_calls)
      && (e.tool_calls as any[]).some(tc => tc?.name === 'finalize')
  );

  console.log();
  console.log('--- CHECKS ---');
  console.log('executor_exhausted event:', !!exhaustedEvent);
  console.log('critic finalized:', !!criticFinalize);
  console.log('stop reason:', stopEvent?.reason);

  let failures = 0;
  if (!exhaustedEvent) {
    console.error('FAIL: no executor_exhausted event');
    failures++;
  }
  if (!criticFinalize) {
    console.error("FAIL: Critic did not finalize (didn't receive CONTEXT_LIMIT?)");
    failures++;
  }
  if (!stopEvent || stopEvent.reason !== 'done') {
    console.error(`FAIL: stop reason = ${stopEvent?.reason}, expected done`);
    failures++;
  }

  if (failures === 0) {
    console.log();
    console.log('=== SUCCESS: 409 per-agent handled correctly ===');
    process.exit(0);
  } else {
    console.log();
    console.log(`=== FAILURE: ${failures} checks failed ===`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

main().catch(e => {
  console.error('CRASH:', e);
  process.exit(2);
});
===== END FILE: scripts/probe-409.ts =====

===== FILE: scripts/probe-artifacts.ts =====
/**
 * Unit test for step 31 — artifact lifecycle and chat reset.
 *
 * Mocks ApiClient and Executor. No real API servers needed.
 *
 * Scenarios:
 *   T1. No .pingis/plan.md -> newChat() called for both agents.
 *   T2. .pingis/plan.md present -> newChat() not called.
 *   T3. Done without Critic writing summary.md -> orchestrator writes
 *       a fallback summary; plan.md removed (clean done).
 *   T4. Done with Critic writing summary.md -> orchestrator does not
 *       overwrite; plan.md removed (clean done).
 *
 * Run:
 *   npx ts-node --project scripts/tsconfig.json scripts/probe-artifacts.ts
 */

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as os from 'os';
import * as path from 'path';
import { ApiClient } from '../src/api';
import { Executor } from '../src/executor';
import { Logger } from '../src/log';
import { NullPanel, Orchestrator } from '../src/orchestrator';
import { AssistantResponse, ExecResult, StopError } from '../src/types';

let failures = 0;

function check(condition: boolean, label: string): void {
  if (condition) {
    console.log(`  ✓ ${label}`);
  } else {
    console.error(`  ✗ ${label}`);
    failures++;
  }
}

function freshTmp(name: string): string {
  const p = path.join(os.tmpdir(), `${name}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`);
  fs.mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true });
  return p;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Fake APIs
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class FakeApiImmediateExhaust {
  public newChatCalls = 0;
  async newChat(): Promise<void> { this.newChatCalls++; }
  async chat(): Promise<AssistantResponse> {
    throw new StopError('context_exhausted', 'fake');
  }
}

class FakeApiStepScript {
  private step = 0;
  constructor(private who: 'executor' | 'critic', private writeSummary: boolean) {}
  public newChatCalls = 0;
  async newChat(): Promise<void> { this.newChatCalls++; }
  async chat(): Promise<AssistantResponse> {
    this.step++;
    const mk = (name: any, args: any): AssistantResponse => ({
      text: '',
      tool_calls: [{ id: `call_${this.step}`, name, args } as any],
      raw: {}
    });
    if (this.who === 'executor') {
      if (this.step === 1) return mk('execute', { script: 'print("noop")' });
      if (this.step === 2) return mk('send_message', { to: 'critic', message: 'ALL DONE: finished' });
    } else {
      if (this.step === 1) {
        const script = this.writeSummary
          ? 'pathlib.Path(".pingis/summary.md").write_text("MARKER", encoding="utf-8")'
          : 'print("noop")';
        return mk('execute', { script });
      }
      if (this.step === 2) return mk('finalize', { comment: 'done' });
    }
    throw new Error(`exhausted: ${this.who} step ${this.step}`);
  }
}

class FakeExecutor {
  constructor(private cwd: string) {}
  async run(call_id: string, script: string): Promise<ExecResult> {
    if (script.includes('summary.md')) {
      const dir = path.join(this.cwd, '.pingis');
      fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
      fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'summary.md'), '# Task summary\n\nMarker written by fake executor.\n');
    }
    return {
      call_id,
      command: 'noop',
      exit_code: 0,
      duration_ms: 1,
      stdout: 'ok\n',
      stderr: '',
      stdout_truncated: false,
      stderr_truncated: false
    };
  }
}

function makeLog(cwd: string): Logger {
  return new Logger(cwd, { appendLine: () => { /* silent */ } });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// T1 / T2 — chat reset decision
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

async function t1_noPlan_resetsChats(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT1: no plan.md -> newChat() called for both agents');
  const cwd = freshTmp('probe-artifacts-t1');
  const apiE = new FakeApiImmediateExhaust();
  const apiC = new FakeApiImmediateExhaust();
  const log = makeLog(cwd);

  const orch = new Orchestrator(
    apiE as unknown as ApiClient,
    apiC as unknown as ApiClient,
    new FakeExecutor(cwd) as unknown as Executor,
    new NullPanel(),
    log,
    {
      cwd, name: 't1', task: 'stub',
      timeoutMs: 10_000,
      executorPrompt: 'E', criticPrompt: 'C'
    }
  );

  await orch.run();
  log.close();

  check(apiE.newChatCalls === 1, `executor newChat called once (got ${apiE.newChatCalls})`);
  check(apiC.newChatCalls === 1, `critic newChat called once (got ${apiC.newChatCalls})`);
}

async function t2_withPlan_doesNotReset(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT2: plan.md present -> newChat() not called');
  const cwd = freshTmp('probe-artifacts-t2');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md'), '# Plan\n');

  const apiE = new FakeApiImmediateExhaust();
  const apiC = new FakeApiImmediateExhaust();
  const log = makeLog(cwd);

  const orch = new Orchestrator(
    apiE as unknown as ApiClient,
    apiC as unknown as ApiClient,
    new FakeExecutor(cwd) as unknown as Executor,
    new NullPanel(),
    log,
    {
      cwd, name: 't2', task: 'stub',
      timeoutMs: 10_000,
      executorPrompt: 'E', criticPrompt: 'C'
    }
  );

  await orch.run();
  log.close();

  check(apiE.newChatCalls === 0, `executor newChat not called (got ${apiE.newChatCalls})`);
  check(apiC.newChatCalls === 0, `critic newChat not called (got ${apiC.newChatCalls})`);
}

async function t3_doneWithoutSummary_writesFallback(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT3: done without Critic summary -> fallback written; plan deleted');
  const cwd = freshTmp('probe-artifacts-t3');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md'), '# Plan\nOriginal plan content.\n');

  const apiE = new FakeApiStepScript('executor', false);
  const apiC = new FakeApiStepScript('critic', false);
  const log = makeLog(cwd);

  const orch = new Orchestrator(

    new NullPanel(),

    {
      cwd, name: 't3', task: 'stub task',
      timeoutMs: 30_000,
      executorPrompt: 'E', criticPrompt: 'C'
    }
  );

  await orch.run();
  log.close();

  const summaryPath = path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'summary.md');
  const planPath = path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md');

async function t4_doneWithSummary_keepsCriticVersion(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT4: done with Critic summary -> not overwritten; plan deleted');
  const cwd = freshTmp('probe-artifacts-t4');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md'), '# Plan\n');

  const apiE = new FakeApiStepScript('executor', false);
  const apiC = new FakeApiStepScript('critic', true);
  const log = makeLog(cwd);

  const orch = new Orchestrator(
    apiE as unknown as ApiClient,

      timeoutMs: 30_000,
      executorPrompt: 'E', criticPrompt: 'C'
    }
  );

  await orch.run();
  log.close();

  const summaryPath = path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'summary.md');
  const planPath = path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md');
  check(fs.existsSync(summaryPath), 'summary.md exists');
  if (fs.existsSync(summaryPath)) {
    const text = fs.readFileSync(summaryPath, 'utf-8');
    check(text.includes('Marker written by fake executor'), 'summary left untouched by orchestrator');
    check(!text.includes('fallback'), 'fallback marker absent');
  }
  check(!fs.existsSync(planPath), 'plan.md deleted on clean done');
}

  console.log('stdout:', JSON.stringify(result.stdout));
  console.log('stderr:', JSON.stringify(result.stderr));

===== FILE: scripts/probe-help-protocol.ts =====
/**
 * Unit test for the unified HELP protocol.
 *
 * T1. Broken JSON with a valid "message" is salvaged. Dialog continues.
 * T2. Three garbage attempts in a row → orchestrator HELP, no
 *     protocol_violation stop. IMPOSSIBLE from the other agent ends
 *     the task with reason deadlock.
 * T3. HELP → HELP_RESPONSE → SOLVED → done.
 * T4. IMPOSSIBLE from Executor → stop('deadlock'); plan preserved.
 * T5. Help loop across two full rounds — orchestrator HELP fires
 *     more than once; the task ends with IMPOSSIBLE, not with a
 *     hard stop.
 *
 * Run:
 *   npx ts-node --project scripts/tsconfig.json scripts/probe-help-protocol.ts
 */

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as os from 'os';
import * as path from 'path';
import { ApiClient } from '../src/api';
import { Executor } from '../src/executor';
import { Logger } from '../src/log';
import { NullPanel, Orchestrator } from '../src/orchestrator';
import { AssistantResponse, ExecResult } from '../src/types';

let failures = 0;

function check(condition: boolean, label: string): void {
  if (condition) {
    console.log(`  \u2713 ${label}`);
  } else {
    console.error(`  \u2717 ${label}`);
    failures++;
  }
}

function freshTmp(name: string): string {
  const p = path.join(os.tmpdir(),
    `${name}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`);
  fs.mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true });
  return p;
}

type Step =
  | { kind: 'broken'; text: string }
  | { kind: 'tools'; calls: { name: string; args: any }[] };

class FakeApi {
  public newChatCalls = 0;
  constructor(private who: string, private script: Step[]) {}
  private idx = 0;
  async newChat(): Promise<void> { this.newChatCalls++; }
  async chat(): Promise<AssistantResponse> {
    if (this.idx >= this.script.length) {
      throw new Error(`FakeApi(${this.who}): script exhausted`);
    }
    const s = this.script[this.idx++];
    if (s.kind === 'broken') {
      return { text: s.text, tool_calls: [], raw: {} };
    }
    return {
      text: '',
      tool_calls: s.calls.map((c, i) => ({
        id: `call_${this.idx}_${i}`,
        name: c.name as any,
        args: c.args
      })) as any,
      raw: {}
    };
  }
}

class FakeExecutor {
  async run(call_id: string, script: string): Promise<ExecResult> {
    return {
      call_id, command: 'noop', exit_code: 0, duration_ms: 1,
      stdout: 'ok\n', stderr: '',
      stdout_truncated: false, stderr_truncated: false
    };
  }
}

function mkLog(cwd: string): Logger {
  return new Logger(cwd, { appendLine: () => { /* silent */ } });
}

async function runOrch(
  cwd: string,
  apiE: FakeApi,
  apiC: FakeApi,
  task = 'stub'
): Promise<void> {
  const log = mkLog(cwd);
  const orch = new Orchestrator(
    apiE as unknown as ApiClient,
    apiC as unknown as ApiClient,
    new FakeExecutor() as unknown as Executor,
    new NullPanel(),
    log,
    {
      cwd, name: 'probe-help-protocol', task,
      timeoutMs: 30_000,
      executorPrompt: 'E', criticPrompt: 'C'
    }
  );
  await orch.run();
  log.close();
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200));
}

function readLog(cwd: string): any[] {
  const logPath = path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'session.log');
  if (!fs.existsSync(logPath)) return [];
  return fs.readFileSync(logPath, 'utf-8')
    .split('\n').filter(Boolean).map(l => JSON.parse(l));
}

async function t1_salvage_from_broken_message(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT1: broken JSON with valid "message" is salvaged');

  const cwd = freshTmp('probe-hp-t1');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md'), '# Plan\n');

  const brokenJson =
    '{"tool_calls":[{"name":"send_message","arguments":' +
    '{"to":"critic","message":"APPROVE_PLAN"';

  const apiE = new FakeApi('executor', [
    { kind: 'broken', text: brokenJson }
  ]);
  const apiC = new FakeApi('critic', [
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'execute', args: { script: 'print(1)' } }] },
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'finalize', args: { comment: 'ok' } }] }
  ]);

  await runOrch(cwd, apiE, apiC);
  const lines = readLog(cwd);

  const salvaged = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'response' && e.salvaged === true
      && e.kind === 'message_extracted'
  );
  const routed = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'route' && e.from === 'executor' && e.to === 'critic'
      && typeof e.message === 'string' && e.message.includes('APPROVE_PLAN')
  );
  const stop = lines.find(e => e.event === 'stop');

  check(!!salvaged, 'message_extracted salvage event present');
  check(!!routed, 'APPROVE_PLAN routed to critic');
  check(stop?.reason === 'done', `stop reason = ${stop?.reason} (expected done)`);
}

async function t2_garbage_escalates_to_help(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT2: three garbage attempts → HELP, then IMPOSSIBLE');

  const cwd = freshTmp('probe-hp-t2');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md'), '# Plan\n');

  const apiE = new FakeApi('executor', [
    { kind: 'broken', text: 'not json at all' },
    { kind: 'broken', text: 'still garbage' },
    { kind: 'broken', text: 'garbage again' },
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'critic', message: 'IMPOSSIBLE: cannot reformat' } }] }
  ]);
  const apiC = new FakeApi('critic', [
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'executor', message: 'HELP_RESPONSE: try shorter' } }] }
  ]);

  await runOrch(cwd, apiE, apiC);
  const lines = readLog(cwd);

  const retry1 = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'error' && e.code === 'no_tool_calls' && e.retry === 1
  );
  const retry2 = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'error' && e.code === 'no_tool_calls' && e.retry === 2
  );
  const orchHelp = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'help' && e.initiator === 'orchestrator'
  );
  const stop = lines.find(e => e.event === 'stop');

  check(!!retry1, 'retry 1 (L1a) logged');
  check(!!retry2, 'retry 2 (L1b) logged');
  check(!!orchHelp, 'orchestrator-initiated HELP logged');
  check(stop?.reason !== 'protocol_violation',
    `stop reason = ${stop?.reason} (must not be protocol_violation)`);
  check(stop?.reason === 'deadlock',
    `stop reason = ${stop?.reason} (expected deadlock from IMPOSSIBLE)`);
}

async function t3_help_loop_and_solved(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT3: HELP → HELP_RESPONSE → SOLVED → done');

  const cwd = freshTmp('probe-hp-t3');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md'), '# Plan\n');

  const apiE = new FakeApi('executor', [
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'critic', message: 'HELP:\nProblem: x\nTried: y' } }] },
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'critic', message: 'SOLVED: it worked' } }] },
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'critic', message: 'ALL DONE: ok' } }] }
  ]);
  const apiC = new FakeApi('critic', [
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'execute', args: { script: 'print(1)' } }] },
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'executor', message: 'HELP_RESPONSE: try X' } }] },
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'finalize', args: { comment: 'ok' } }] }
  ]);

  await runOrch(cwd, apiE, apiC);
  const lines = readLog(cwd);

  const helpSent = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'help' && e.phase === 'HELP'
  );
  const helpResp = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'help' && e.phase === 'HELP_RESPONSE'
  );
  const solved = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'help' && e.phase === 'SOLVED'
  );
  const stop = lines.find(e => e.event === 'stop');

  check(!!helpSent, 'HELP event logged');
  check(!!helpResp, 'HELP_RESPONSE event logged');
  check(!!solved, 'SOLVED event logged');
  check(stop?.reason === 'done', `stop reason = ${stop?.reason} (expected done)`);
}

async function t4_impossible_stops_task(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT4: IMPOSSIBLE → deadlock, plan preserved');

  const cwd = freshTmp('probe-hp-t4');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md'), '# Plan\nreal content\n');

  const apiE = new FakeApi('executor', [
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'critic', message: 'IMPOSSIBLE: cannot solve' } }] }
  ]);
  const apiC = new FakeApi('critic', []);

  await runOrch(cwd, apiE, apiC);
  const lines = readLog(cwd);

  const stop = lines.find(e => e.event === 'stop');
  const summary = path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'summary.md');
  const plan = path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md');

  check(stop?.reason === 'deadlock',
    `stop reason = ${stop?.reason} (expected deadlock)`);
  check(fs.existsSync(summary), 'fallback summary written');
  check(fs.existsSync(plan), 'plan.md preserved (graceful shutdown)');
}

async function t5_help_loop_no_stop(): Promise<void> {

    { kind: 'broken', text: 'r1 garbage b' },
    { kind: 'broken', text: 'r1 garbage c' },
    { kind: 'broken', text: 'r2 garbage a' },
    { kind: 'broken', text: 'r2 garbage b' },

===== FILE: scripts/probe-help.ts =====
/**
 * Unit test for the HELP protocol.
 *
 * Mocks ApiClient and Executor. No real API servers needed.
 * Checks:
 *   1. Executor sends HELP: -> Critic receives it.
 *   2. Critic replies HELP_RESPONSE: -> Executor receives it.
 *   3. Executor eventually sends ALL DONE -> Critic finalizes.
 *   4. stop reason=done.
 *
 * Run:
 *   npx ts-node --project scripts/tsconfig.json scripts/probe-help.ts
 */

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as os from 'os';
import * as path from 'path';
import { ApiClient } from '../src/api';
import { Executor } from '../src/executor';
import { Logger } from '../src/log';
import { NullPanel, Orchestrator } from '../src/orchestrator';
import { AssistantResponse, ExecResult } from '../src/types';

const TMP = path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'probe-help-' + Date.now());
fs.mkdirSync(TMP, { recursive: true });
console.log('TMP:', TMP);

const log = new Logger(TMP, {
  appendLine: (s: string) => console.log(s)
});

type Step =
  | 'execute'
  | 'send_help'
  | 'send_all_done'
  | 'send_help_response'
  | 'send_approve_stage'
  | 'finalize';

class FakeApi {
  private count = 0;
  constructor(
    private who: string,
    private script: Step[]
  ) {}

  async newChat(): Promise<void> { /* no-op */ }

  async chat(): Promise<AssistantResponse> {
    const step = this.script[this.count++];
    console.log(`[fake-${this.who}] step #${this.count}: ${step}`);
    if (!step) throw new Error('script exhausted for ' + this.who);

    const mk = (args: any): AssistantResponse => ({
      text: '',
      tool_calls: [{
        id: `call_${this.count}`,
        name: args.name,
        args: args.args
      } as any],
      raw: {}
    });

    if (step === 'execute') {
      return mk({ name: 'execute', args: { script: 'print("noop")' } });
    }
    if (step === 'send_help') {
      return mk({
        name: 'send_message',
        args: {
          to: 'critic',
          message:
            'HELP:\n' +
            'Problem: regex fails on IPv6 addresses.\n' +
            'Error: ValueError: no match at position 0\n' +
            'Tried: \\S+ for ip; \\S+ for url; \\[.+\\] for ts\n' +
            'Files: /tmp/help-test/loganalyzer/parser.py\n' +
            'Question: how to match IPv6 in the ip field?'
        }
      });
    }
    if (step === 'send_all_done') {
      return mk({
        name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'critic', message: 'ALL DONE: parser works on all cases.' }
      });
    }
    if (step === 'send_help_response') {
      return mk({
        name: 'send_message',
        args: {
          to: 'executor',
          message:
            'HELP_RESPONSE: use a bracketed class for ip: ' +
            String.raw`(?P<ip>\[[0-9a-fA-F:]+\]|[0-9.]+)`
        }
      });
    }
    if (step === 'send_approve_stage') {
      return mk({
        name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'executor', message: 'APPROVE_STAGE' }
      });
    }
    if (step === 'finalize') {
      return mk({
        name: 'finalize',
        args: { comment: 'Parser verified on all edge cases.' }
      });
    }
    throw new Error('unknown step: ' + step);
  }
}

class FakeExecutor {
  async run(call_id: string, script: string, command?: string): Promise<ExecResult> {
    console.log(`[fake-exec] script len=${script.length}`);
    return {
      call_id,
      command: command ?? 'noop',
      exit_code: 0,
      duration_ms: 1,
      stdout: 'noop\n',
      stderr: '',
      stdout_truncated: false,
      stderr_truncated: false
    };
  }
}

// --- Scenario ---
//
// E: execute              (stuck)
// E: send_help            -> C
// C: execute              (reads files)
// C: send_help_response   -> E
// E: execute              (applies fix)
// E: send_all_done        -> C
// C: execute              (verifies)
// C: finalize
//
// We simulate the natural flow. The exact number of execute calls on
// each side does not matter — what matters is that HELP and
// HELP_RESPONSE travel through the orchestrator's routing table.

const fakeApiE = new FakeApi('executor', [
  'execute',
  'send_help',
  'execute',
  'send_all_done'
]);

const fakeApiC = new FakeApi('critic', [
  'execute',              // reads files after HELP
  'send_help_response',   // replies HELP_RESPONSE
  'execute',              // verifies after ALL DONE
  'finalize'
]);

async function main() {
  const orch = new Orchestrator(
    fakeApiE as unknown as ApiClient,
    fakeApiC as unknown as ApiClient,
    new FakeExecutor() as unknown as Executor,
    new NullPanel(),
    log,
    {
      cwd: TMP,
      name: 'probe-help',
      task: 'Stub task for HELP protocol test.',
      timeoutMs: 60_000,
      executorPrompt: 'EXECUTOR_PROMPT',
      criticPrompt: 'CRITIC_PROMPT'
    }
  );

  await orch.run();
  log.close();

  const logPath = path.join(TMP, '.pingis', 'session.log');
  const text = await readLogWhenReady(logPath);
  const lines = text.split('\n').filter(Boolean).map(l => JSON.parse(l));

  const helpRoute = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'route'
      && e.from === 'executor'
      && e.to === 'critic'
      && String(e.message ?? '').startsWith('HELP:')
  );
  const helpResponseRoute = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'route'
      && e.from === 'critic'
      && e.to === 'executor'
      && String(e.message ?? '').startsWith('HELP_RESPONSE:')
  );
  const stopEvent = lines.find(e => e.event === 'stop');
  const helpEvent = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'help' && e.phase === 'HELP'
  );
  const helpResponseEvent = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'help' && e.phase === 'HELP_RESPONSE'
  );

  console.log();
  console.log('--- CHECKS ---');
  console.log('HELP route found:', !!helpRoute);
  console.log('HELP_RESPONSE route found:', !!helpResponseRoute);
  console.log('help event (request):', !!helpEvent);
  console.log('help event (response):', !!helpResponseEvent);
  console.log('stop reason:', stopEvent?.reason);

  let failures = 0;
  if (!helpRoute)         { console.error('FAIL: no HELP route'); failures++; }
  if (!helpResponseRoute) { console.error('FAIL: no HELP_RESPONSE route'); failures++; }
  if (!helpEvent)         { console.error('FAIL: no help (request) event'); failures++; }
  if (!helpResponseEvent) { console.error('FAIL: no help (response) event'); failures++; }
  if (!stopEvent || stopEvent.reason !== 'done') {
    console.error(`FAIL: stop reason = ${stopEvent?.reason}, expected done`);
    failures++;
  }

  if (failures === 0) {
    console.log();
    console.log('=== SUCCESS: HELP protocol works ===');
    process.exit(0);
  } else {
    console.log();
    console.log(`=== FAILURE: ${failures} checks failed ===`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

async function readLogWhenReady(logPath: string, timeoutMs = 3000): Promise<string> {
  const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
  while (Date.now() < deadline) {
    if (fs.existsSync(logPath)) {
      const text = fs.readFileSync(logPath, 'utf-8');
      if (text.includes('"event":"stop"')) return text;
    }
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 50));
  }
  return fs.existsSync(logPath) ? fs.readFileSync(logPath, 'utf-8') : '';
}

main().catch(e => {
  console.error('CRASH:', e);
  process.exit(2);
});

===== FILE: scripts/probe-retry.ts =====
/**
 * Unit test for step 34 — runWithRetry().
 *
 * Run:
 *   npx ts-node --project scripts/tsconfig.json scripts/probe-retry.ts
 */

import { runWithRetry } from '../src/retry';
import { OrchestratorResult, StopReason } from '../src/types';

let failures = 0;

function check(condition: boolean, label: string): void {
  if (condition) {
    console.log(`  ✓ ${label}`);
  } else {
    console.error(`  ✗ ${label}`);
    failures++;
  }
}

function freshRunWithRetry(
  script: StopReason[],
  opts: {
    maxRetries?: number;
    backoffMs?: number[];
    totalTimeoutMs?: number;
    taskStartedAtOffset?: number;
  } = {}
): Promise<{ result: OrchestratorResult; attempts: number; retries: number; logs: any[] }> {
  let attempts = 0;
  let retries = 0;
  const logs: any[] = [];
  const scriptCopy = [...script];

  return runWithRetry({
    taskStartedAt: Date.now() - (opts.taskStartedAtOffset ?? 0),
    totalTimeoutMs: opts.totalTimeoutMs ?? 60_000,
    maxRetries: opts.maxRetries ?? 3,
    backoffMs: opts.backoffMs ?? [1, 1, 1],
    minRemainingMs: 100,
    isRetryable: (r) =>
      r === 'network_error' || r === 'bad_gateway' || r === 'server_error',
    runOnce: async () => {
      attempts++;
      const r = scriptCopy.shift() ?? 'done';
      return { reason: r };
    },
    onRetry: async () => {
      retries++;
    },
    log: (event, payload) => logs.push({ event, ...payload })
  }).then(result => ({ result, attempts, retries, logs }));
}

async function t1_retry_then_success(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT1: network_error, then done');
  const { result, attempts, retries } = await freshRunWithRetry([
    'network_error', 'done'
  ]);
  check(result.reason === 'done', `result = ${result.reason} (expected done)`);
  check(attempts === 2, `attempts = ${attempts} (expected 2)`);
  check(retries === 1, `retries = ${retries} (expected 1)`);
}

async function t2_retries_exhausted(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT2: four network_errors, budget exhausted');
  const { result, attempts, retries } = await freshRunWithRetry(
    ['network_error', 'network_error', 'network_error', 'network_error']
  );
  check(result.reason === 'network_error',
    `result = ${result.reason} (expected network_error)`);
  check(attempts === 4, `attempts = ${attempts} (expected 4)`);
  check(retries === 3, `retries = ${retries} (expected 3)`);
}

async function t3_non_retryable(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT3: server_busy — not retryable');
  const { result, attempts, retries } = await freshRunWithRetry([
    'server_busy', 'done'
  ]);
  check(result.reason === 'server_busy',
    `result = ${result.reason} (expected server_busy)`);
  check(attempts === 1, `attempts = ${attempts} (expected 1)`);
  check(retries === 0, `retries = ${retries} (expected 0)`);
}

async function t4_done_immediate(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT4: done on first attempt');
  const { result, attempts, retries } = await freshRunWithRetry(['done']);
  check(result.reason === 'done', `result = ${result.reason}`);
  check(attempts === 1, `attempts = ${attempts}`);
  check(retries === 0, `retries = ${retries}`);
}

async function t5_time_budget_exhausted(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT5: no attempts — budget already gone');
  const { result, attempts, retries, logs } = await freshRunWithRetry(
    ['done'],
    { totalTimeoutMs: 60_000, taskStartedAtOffset: 100_000 }
  );
  check(result.reason === 'crash',
    `result = ${result.reason} (expected crash — the default)`);
  check(attempts === 0, `attempts = ${attempts} (expected 0)`);
  check(retries === 0, `retries = ${retries}`);
  const abort = logs.find(l => l.event === 'retry_abort');
  check(!!abort, 'retry_abort logged');
  check(abort?.reason === 'time_budget_exhausted',
    `abort reason = ${abort?.reason}`);
}

async function main(): Promise<void> {
  await t1_retry_then_success();
  await t2_retries_exhausted();
  await t3_non_retryable();
  await t4_done_immediate();
  await t5_time_budget_exhausted();

  console.log();
  if (failures === 0) {
    console.log('=== SUCCESS: retry loop works ===');
    process.exit(0);
  } else {
    console.log(`=== FAILURE: ${failures} check(s) failed ===`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

main().catch(e => {
  console.error('CRASH:', e);
  process.exit(2);
});

===== FILE: src/api-process.ts =====
import { spawn, ChildProcess } from 'child_process';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import { Logger } from './log';
import {
  AgentsDeployment,
  deploymentExists,
  loadAgentsDeployment
} from './config';

const STARTUP_TIMEOUT_MS = 240_000;

/**
 * Orchestrates the multi-agent deployment produced by
 * make-multi-agent.sh.
 *
 * Lifecycle:
 *   ensureRunning():
 *     - if deployment folder missing → build it with make-multi-agent.sh
 *     - if both agents already answer /v1/context/status → nothing to do
 *     - else → run scripts/start-all.sh, wait for readiness
 *   stop():
 *     - if we started the agents ourselves → run scripts/stop-all.sh
 */
export class AgentsProcess {
  private deployment: AgentsDeployment;
  private startedByUs = false;

  constructor(
    apiDir: string,
    private log: Logger
  ) {
    this.deployment = loadAgentsDeployment(apiDir);
  }

  get executor() { return this.deployment.executor; }
  get critic() { return this.deployment.critic; }

  async ensureRunning(): Promise<void> {
    if (!deploymentExists(this.deployment)) {
      this.buildDeployment();
      // reload after build — ports and keys are now on disk
      this.deployment = loadAgentsDeployment(this.deployment.apiDir);
    }

    if (await this.bothReady()) {
      this.log.event('orchestrator', 'api_ready', {
        agents_dir: this.deployment.root,
        reused: true
      });
      return;
    }

    const script = path.join(this.deployment.root, 'scripts', 'start-all.sh');
    this.log.event('orchestrator', 'api_spawn', {
      agents_dir: this.deployment.root,
      script
    });

    await this.runStartScript(script, 'start-all.sh');

    this.startedByUs = true;

    await this.waitBothReady(STARTUP_TIMEOUT_MS);

    this.log.event('orchestrator', 'api_ready', {
      agents_dir: this.deployment.root,
      reused: false
    });
  }

  stop(): void {
    if (!this.startedByUs) return;
    this.startedByUs = false;

    const script = path.join(this.deployment.root, 'scripts', 'stop-all.sh');
    if (!fs.existsSync(script)) return;

    this.log.event('orchestrator', 'api_exit', {
      reason: 'stop_requested',
      script
    });

    const child = spawn(`bash "${script}"`, {
      cwd: this.deployment.root,
      shell: true,
      detached: false,
      windowsHide: true,
      stdio: 'ignore'
    });
    child.on('error', () => { /* ignore */ });
  }

  // --- deployment build ---

  private buildDeployment(): void {
    const script = path.join(
      this.deployment.apiDir, 'tools', 'make-multi-agent.sh'
    );
    if (!fs.existsSync(script)) {
      throw new Error(
        `make-multi-agent.sh not found: ${script}. ` +
        `Update your DeepSeek Automation API clone.`
      );
    }

    const targetRoot = path.dirname(this.deployment.root); // ~/.pingis
    fs.mkdirSync(targetRoot, { recursive: true });

    this.log.event('orchestrator', 'api_spawn', {
      reason: 'build_deployment',
      script,
      target: targetRoot
    });

    const result = runSync(
      `bash "${script}" "${targetRoot}" --agents 2 --base-port 3098 --force`,
      targetRoot
    );

    if (result.code !== 0) {
      throw new Error(
        `make-multi-agent.sh failed (exit ${result.code}).\n` +
        `${result.stderr || result.stdout}`
      );
    }

    this.log.raw('[agents] deployment built: ' + this.deployment.root);
  }

  // --- readiness ---

  private async bothReady(): Promise<boolean> {
    const [a, b] = await Promise.all([
      this.pingContextStatus(this.deployment.executor),
      this.pingContextStatus(this.deployment.critic)
    ]);
    return a && b;
  }

  private async waitBothReady(timeoutMs: number): Promise<void> {
    const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
    while (Date.now() < deadline) {
      if (await this.bothReady()) return;
      await sleep(2000);
    }
    throw new Error(
      `Agents did not become ready within ${Math.round(timeoutMs / 1000)}s. ` +
      `Check ${this.deployment.root}/agents/agent-1/agent.log and agent-2.`
    );
  }

  private async pingContextStatus(agent: { port: number; apiKey: string }): Promise<boolean> {
    if (!agent.port || !agent.apiKey) return false;
    try {
      const controller = new AbortController();
      const t = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 2000);
      const r = await fetch(
        `http://127.0.0.1:${agent.port}/v1/context/status`,
        {
          headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${agent.apiKey}` },
          signal: controller.signal
        }
      );
      clearTimeout(t);
      return r.status === 200;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  // --- scripts ---

  private async runStartScript(script: string, label: string): Promise<void> {
    this.log.raw(`[agents] running ${label}`);
    const result = await new Promise<{ code: number; stdout: string; stderr: string }>(
      (resolve) => {
        const child = spawn(`bash "${script}"`, {
          cwd: this.deployment.root,
          shell: true,
          detached: false,
          windowsHide: true
        });
        let stdout = '', stderr = '';
        child.stdout.on('data', (c: Buffer) => {
          const s = c.toString('utf-8');
          stdout += s;
          for (const line of s.split(/\r?\n/)) {
            if (line.trim()) this.log.raw(`[agents] ${line}`);
          }
        });
        child.stderr.on('data', (c: Buffer) => {
          const s = c.toString('utf-8');
          stderr += s;
          for (const line of s.split(/\r?\n/)) {
            if (line.trim()) this.log.raw(`[agents] ${line}`);
          }
        });
        child.on('exit', (code) => resolve({ code: code ?? -1, stdout, stderr }));
        child.on('error', (e) => resolve({ code: -1, stdout, stderr: String(e) }));
      }
    );

    if (result.code !== 0) {
      throw new Error(
        `${label} failed (exit ${result.code}).\n` +
        `${result.stderr.split('\n').slice(-10).join('\n')}`
      );
    }
  }
}

function runSync(cmd: string, cwd: string): { code: number; stdout: string; stderr: string } {
  const { execSync } = require('child_process');
  try {
    const stdout = execSync(cmd, { cwd, encoding: 'utf-8', shell: true, windowsHide: true });
    return { code: 0, stdout, stderr: '' };
  } catch (e: any) {
    return {
      code: e.status ?? -1,
      stdout: String(e.stdout ?? ''),
      stderr: String(e.stderr ?? e.message ?? '')
    };
  }
}

function sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, ms));
}
